title: doc-cartographer
description: Use this when you need the FACTS subagent for the documentation trio. Given a scope (a directory with a manifest), it classifies the scope type, recalls the best-in-class doc frameworks from memory, drives GitNexus to discover the REAL features (tagged shipped/roadmap/deprecated with runnable receipts), assesses the existing doc surface for junk/redundancy/gaps, records public distribution + freshness, surfaces missing verification tools, and logs three health metrics per run. Writes only to <scope>/docs/marketing/.catalog/. Never writes prose docs, never guesses. Dispatched by doc-steward.
author: sox-ecosystem

invocation.description: Declarative agent — host reads the prose body and renders the host header from agent/render at install time.
